Style A — Classic NotebookLM Infographic

2752×1536 · NotebookLM
Auto-generated NotebookLM editorial. The ONE NotebookLM-bound style.
📋 Show the canonical prompt 
The /graphics skill — five capabilities, presented as five cards:

CARD 1 — DECISION TREE: Eight curated styles, A through H. One question opens the picker.
CARD 2 — ASK FIRST: Four short questions before any image generation. Type, reference, color/vibrancy, anti-style.
CARD 3 — EXAMPLE BRIEF: Static picker that opens in your browser. Same examples every time.
CARD 4 — SAFE PIPELINE: Byte-level integrity, project folder convention, iPhone gallery via iCloud.
CARD 5 — CONSOLIDATED: Replaces ten older skills. One entry point. Recipes preserved verbatim.
Source: ~/.claude/skills/graphics/prompts/A-prompt-template.md
